CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_agent_downline_rake_summary(p_agent_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_club_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_since timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_until timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_root uuid := COALESCE(p_agent_user_id, auth.uid());
  v_from timestamptz := COALESCE(p_since, public.fn_union_week_start(now()));
  v_to   timestamptz := COALESCE(p_until, now());
  v_rate numeric;
  v_authorized_clubs uuid[];
  v_members int := 0; v_active int := 0; v_direct int := 0; v_subs int := 0;
  v_hands bigint := 0; v_rake numeric := 0; v_last timestamptz;
  v_top_name text; v_top_rake numeric;
BEGIN
  v_authorized_clubs := public.fn_ca_authorized_agent_data_clubs(v_root, p_club_id);
  SELECT a.commission_rate INTO v_rate
    FROM agents a
   WHERE a.user_id = v_root AND a.status='active'
     AND a.club_id = ANY(v_authorized_clubs)
   ORDER BY a.commission_rate DESC NULLS LAST
   LIMIT 1;

  -- One execution, one pass.
  SELECT count(*),
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.hands > 0),
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.depth = 1),
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.role IN ('agent','sub_agent','super_agent')),
         COALESCE(SUM(d.hands), 0),
         COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(d.rake_generated), 2), 0),
         MAX(d.last_hand_at),
         (array_agg(d.username     ORDER BY d.rake_generated DESC))[1],
         (array_agg(d.rake_generated ORDER BY d.rake_generated DESC))[1]
    INTO v_members, v_active, v_direct, v_subs, v_hands, v_rake, v_last,
         v_top_name, v_top_rake
    FROM public.fn_agent_downline_rake(v_root, p_club_id, v_from, v_to, NULL, 100000) d;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'period_start', v_from,
    'period_end',   v_to,
    'members',      v_members,
    'active',       v_active,
    'direct',       v_direct,
    'sub_agents',   v_subs,
    'hands',        v_hands,
    'rake_generated', v_rake,
    'commission_rate', COALESCE(v_rate, 0),
    'estimated_commission', ROUND(v_rake * COALESCE(v_rate, 0), 2),
    'last_hand_at', v_last,
    'top_earner', CASE WHEN v_top_name IS NULL THEN NULL
                       ELSE jsonb_build_object('username', v_top_name, 'rake', v_top_rake) END
  );
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_club_game_recent_rows_chicago_basis(p_club_id uuid, p_start date, p_end date, p_limit integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_limit integer := GREATEST(LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit,100),200),1);
  v_bound timestamptz;
  v_out jsonb;
BEGIN
  /* THE NEWEST GAMES, READ NEWEST FIRST (20261022165130).

     ca_club_data_snapshot_v2 shows the unfiltered game page's rows in its
     'recent' order: newest start first (a cash table's created_at, a
     tournament's start_time), then kind, then id. ca_club_game_page_core
     ranks every game of the window to pick them, which for a large club is
     200,000 tournaments read from tournaments every call (4 to 6 s). Here the
     tournaments are walked newest first down idx_tournaments_start_time,
     keeping those this club played in the window, and they stop at the
     page's size: the top of every game is the top of the cash tables (read
     whole, as before) and the top tournaments.

     The walk goes no further than the 20,000th newest start ($10), and reads
     the reporting clubs once ($11, fn_ca_club_data_clubs) rather than once
     per tournament walked. When the
     page's last tournament is newer than that bound every tournament that
     could outrank it was walked, and the rows are the page's rows exactly;
     otherwise this answers NULL and the caller reads the page as before.
     Every row is described by the page's own detail query; for a union the
     raked hands are counted for the page's cash tables only, by the same
     filter as the page's union_hands. The caller has authorized the viewer
     (ca_can_view_whole_club_report). */
  SELECT tr.start_time INTO v_bound FROM public.tournaments tr
   WHERE tr.start_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tr.start_time DESC OFFSET 20000 LIMIT 1;
  v_bound := COALESCE(v_bound, '-infinity'::timestamptz);

  EXECUTE $query$
    WITH felt AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM public.fn_ca_club_cash_felt($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6)), raw_cash AS (
      SELECT c.table_id,SUM(c.rake) fee,SUM(c.net) winnings,SUM(c.hands)::bigint hands
        FROM (SELECT g.game_id AS table_id,g.fee AS rake,g.winnings AS net,0::bigint AS hands
                FROM public.ca_club_data_game_ct g
               WHERE g.kind='CASH' AND g.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs($1)) AND g.stat_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3
              UNION ALL
              SELECT h.table_id,0,0,h.hands
                FROM public.ca_club_data_hands_ct h
               WHERE h.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs($1)) AND h.stat_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3) c
       GROUP BY c.table_id
    ), cash AS (
      SELECT coalesce(c.table_id,f.table_id) table_id,coalesce(c.fee,0) fee,
             coalesce(c.winnings,0)+coalesce(f.felt,0) winnings,coalesce(f.felt,0) on_felt,coalesce(c.hands,0)::bigint hands,
             coalesce(f.seated,0)::integer seated
        FROM raw_cash c FULL JOIN felt f ON f.table_id=c.table_id
    ), tour_top AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT tr.id,tr.start_time,tr.tournament_type
        FROM public.tournaments tr
       WHERE tr.start_time >= $10
         AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.ca_club_data_game_ct d
                      WHERE d.kind='TOURNAMENT' AND d.club_id = ANY ($11)
                        AND d.game_id=tr.id AND d.stat_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3)
       ORDER BY tr.start_time DESC,
                CASE WHEN tr.tournament_type='SPIN' THEN 'SPIN'
                     WHEN tr.tournament_type='SNG' THEN 'SNG' WHEN tr.tournament_type='MTT' THEN 'MTT' ELSE coalesce(tr.tournament_type,'TOURNAMENT') END DESC,
                tr.id::text DESC
       LIMIT $9
    ), keys AS MATERIALIZED (
      -- The ranking set carries the four sort keys and NOTHING the page does
      -- not filter on. Every other column is presentation, it is needed for at
      -- most $9 rows, and carrying it here is what spilled 42 MB to disk three
      -- times per read.
      SELECT 'CASH'::text kind,t.id::text id,
             CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.game_variant,'') ILIKE '%plo%'
                        OR COALESCE(t.game_variant,'') ILIKE '%omaha%' THEN 'OMAHA'
                  WHEN COALESCE(t.game_variant,'') ILIKE '%mixed%'
                        OR COALESCE(t.game_mode,'') ILIKE '%mixed%' THEN 'MIXED'
                  ELSE 'HOLDEM' END game_class,
             CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.big_blind,0)<1 THEN 'MICRO'
                  WHEN COALESCE(t.big_blind,0)<5 THEN 'SMALL'
                  WHEN COALESCE(t.big_blind,0)<25 THEN 'MID' ELSE 'HIGH' END stakes_tier,
             COALESCE(t.name,'Unnamed') name,COALESCE(pr.username,'') creator_name,
             CASE $7 WHEN 'fee' THEN round(c.fee,2)
                     WHEN 'winnings' THEN round(c.winnings,2)
                     WHEN 'hands' THEN c.hands::numeric
                     ELSE extract(epoch FROM COALESCE(t.created_at,'0001-01-01'::timestamptz))::numeric
              END sort_value,
             extract(epoch FROM COALESCE(t.created_at,'0001-01-01'::timestamptz))::numeric sort_time
        FROM cash c JOIN public.tables t ON t.id=c.table_id
        LEFT JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id=t.created_by
      UNION ALL
      SELECT CASE WHEN tr.tournament_type='SPIN' THEN 'SPIN'
                  WHEN tr.tournament_type='SNG' THEN 'SNG' WHEN tr.tournament_type='MTT' THEN 'MTT' ELSE coalesce(tr.tournament_type,'TOURNAMENT') END,
             tr.id::text,
             CASE WHEN tr.tournament_type='SPIN' THEN 'SPIN' WHEN tr.tournament_type='SNG' THEN 'SNG' WHEN tr.tournament_type='MTT' THEN 'MTT' ELSE coalesce(tr.tournament_type,'TOURNAMENT') END,
             'NA',
             NULL::text,''::text,
             extract(epoch FROM COALESCE(tr.start_time,'0001-01-01'::timestamptz))::numeric,
             extract(epoch FROM COALESCE(tr.start_time,'0001-01-01'::timestamptz))::numeric
        FROM tour_top tr
    ), visible AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT * FROM keys
       ORDER BY sort_value DESC,sort_time DESC,kind DESC,id DESC LIMIT $9
    ), visible_hands AS MATERIALIZED (
      -- The page's union_hands, for the page's cash tables only.
      SELECT r.table_id,count(*)::bigint hands
        FROM public.rake_records r
       WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.unions u WHERE u.id=$1)
         AND r.created_at>=$2::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AND r.created_at<($3+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'
         AND r.tournament_id IS NULL AND r.is_tournament IS NOT TRUE AND r.rake_amount>0
         AND r.table_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT h.table_id FROM public.ca_club_data_hands_ct h
                             WHERE h.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs($1)) AND h.stat_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3)
         AND r.table_id::text IN (SELECT v.id FROM visible v WHERE v.kind='CASH')
       GROUP BY r.table_id
    ), detail AS (
      -- Presentation, for the <=$9 rows that survived the LIMIT and no others.
      SELECT v.kind,v.id,CASE WHEN v.kind='CASH' THEN v.name ELSE COALESCE(tr.name,'Tournament') END name,
             v.game_class,v.stakes_tier,v.creator_name,
             v.sort_value,v.sort_time,
             CASE WHEN v.kind='CASH' THEN UPPER(COALESCE(t.game_variant,'nlh'))
                  ELSE UPPER(COALESCE(tr.variant,tr.game_type,'nlh')) END variant,
             CASE WHEN v.kind='CASH' THEN COALESCE(t.small_blind,0) ELSE 0::numeric END small_blind,
             CASE WHEN v.kind='CASH' THEN COALESCE(t.big_blind,0) ELSE 0::numeric END big_blind,
             CASE WHEN v.kind='CASH' AND COALESCE(t.rake_percent,-1)>=0 THEN t.rake_percent END rake_percent,
             CASE WHEN v.kind='CASH' THEN t.created_at ELSE tr.start_time END started_at,
             CASE WHEN v.kind='CASH' THEN t.created_by END created_by,
             CASE WHEN v.kind='CASH' THEN t.status ELSE tr.status END status,
             CASE WHEN v.kind='CASH' THEN round(c.fee,2) ELSE round(COALESCE(f.fee,0),2) END fee,
             CASE WHEN v.kind='CASH' THEN c.fee ELSE coalesce(f.fee,0) END fee_exact,
             CASE WHEN v.kind='CASH' THEN round(c.winnings,2) ELSE round(COALESCE(f.winnings,0),2) END winnings,
             CASE WHEN v.kind='CASH' THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.unions u WHERE u.id=$1) THEN coalesce(vh.hands,0)::bigint ELSE c.hands END ELSE 0::bigint END hands,
             CASE WHEN v.kind='CASH' THEN coalesce(c.on_felt,0) ELSE 0 END on_felt,
             CASE WHEN v.kind='CASH' THEN coalesce(c.on_felt,0)>0 ELSE tr.status='RUNNING' END live,
             CASE WHEN v.kind='CASH' THEN greatest(COALESCE(cp.players,0),COALESCE(c.seated,0))::integer ELSE COALESCE(tp.players,0)::integer END players,
             CASE WHEN v.kind='CASH' THEN pr.avatar_url END creator_avatar
        FROM visible v
        LEFT JOIN cash c ON v.kind='CASH' AND c.table_id=v.id::uuid
        LEFT JOIN public.tables t ON v.kind='CASH' AND t.id=v.id::uuid
        LEFT JOIN visible_hands vh ON v.kind='CASH' AND vh.table_id=v.id::uuid
        LEFT JOIN public.profiles pr ON v.kind='CASH' AND pr.id=t.created_by
        LEFT JOIN public.tournaments tr ON v.kind<>'CASH' AND tr.id=v.id::uuid
        -- The same rows tournament_facts summed for a visible tournament, and
        -- its players in the same window, each read through its own
        -- (club_id, tournament_id, ...) key for the <=$9 visible rows only.
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(d.fee) fee,SUM(d.winnings) winnings
            FROM public.ca_club_data_game_ct d
           WHERE v.kind<>'CASH' AND d.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs($1)) AND d.game_id=v.id::uuid
             AND d.stat_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3
        ) f ON true
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT count(DISTINCT p.user_id)::integer players
            FROM public.ca_stats_club_data_fact_ct p
           WHERE v.kind<>'CASH' AND p.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs($1)) AND p.game_id=v.id::uuid
             AND p.stat_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3 AND p.user_id<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid
        ) tp ON true
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT count(DISTINCT z.user_id)::integer players
            FROM public.ca_stats_club_data_fact_ct z
           WHERE v.kind='CASH' AND z.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs($1)) AND z.stat_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3
             AND z.kind='CASH' AND z.game_id=v.id::uuid AND z.user_id<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid
        ) cp ON true
    )
    SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM tour_top) = $9 AND (SELECT min(t.start_time) FROM tour_top t) > $10 THEN
      COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(

        'kind',q.kind,'id',q.id,'name',q.name,'variant',q.variant,
        'game_class',q.game_class,'stakes_tier',q.stakes_tier,
        'blinds',CASE WHEN q.big_blind>0 THEN
          trim(trailing '.' from trim(trailing '0' from q.small_blind::text))||'/'||
          trim(trailing '.' from trim(trailing '0' from q.big_blind::text)) END,
        'rake_percent',q.rake_percent,'started_at',q.started_at,'status',q.status,
        'creator_id',q.created_by,'creator_name',NULLIF(q.creator_name,''),
        'creator_avatar',q.creator_avatar,'fee',q.fee,'fee_exact',q.fee_exact,'winnings',q.winnings,
        'hands',q.hands,'players',q.players,'on_felt',q.on_felt,'live',q.live)
        ORDER BY q.sort_value DESC,q.sort_time DESC,q.kind DESC,q.id DESC) FROM detail q),'[]'::jsonb) END
  $query$ INTO v_out
  USING p_club_id,p_start,p_end,'ALL'::text,'ALL'::text,NULL::text,'recent'::text,NULL::jsonb,v_limit,v_bound,
        public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id);

  RETURN v_out;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_rake_by_downline(p_agent_user_id uuid, p_club_id uuid, p_since timestamp with time zone, p_until timestamp with time zone, p_limit integer, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'rake'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH listed AS (
    SELECT d.* FROM public.fn_agent_downline_rake(
      p_agent_user_id, p_club_id, p_since, p_until, NULL, 20001) d
  ), totals AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.rake_generated),0) AS total_direct FROM listed l
  ), filtered AS (
    SELECT l.* FROM listed l
     WHERE NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_search,'')),'') IS NULL
        OR COALESCE(l.username,'') ILIKE '%' || public.fn_like_escape(btrim(p_search)) || '%' ESCAPE '\'
  ), page AS (
    SELECT f.* FROM filtered f
     ORDER BY
       CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(p_sort,'rake')) = 'name'  THEN f.username END ASC,
       CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(p_sort,'rake')) = 'hands' THEN f.hands END DESC,
       CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(p_sort,'rake')) NOT IN ('name','hands')
            THEN f.rake_generated END DESC,
       f.username ASC,
       f.player_id::text ASC
     OFFSET GREATEST(COALESCE(p_offset,0),0)
      LIMIT GREATEST(LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit,100),500),1)
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'rows', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'player_id', p.player_id,
              'name', COALESCE(p.username,'Player'),
              'role', p.role,
              'depth', p.depth,
              'upline_user_id', p.upline_user_id,
              'upline_name', p.upline_name,
              'rake', round(COALESCE(p.rake_generated,0),2),
              'hands', COALESCE(p.hands,0),
              'last_hand_at', p.last_hand_at,
              'downline_players', COALESCE(p.downline_players,0),
              'downline_rake', round(COALESCE(p.downline_rake,0),2))) FROM page p), '[]'::jsonb),
    'total', (SELECT count(*) FROM filtered),
    'total_direct', (SELECT t.total_direct FROM totals t),
    'total_commission', NULL);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_club_data_fact_put(p_club uuid, p_day date, p_kind text, p_game uuid, p_user uuid, p_fee numeric, p_buyins numeric, p_cashouts numeric, p_winnings numeric, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  INSERT INTO public.ca_club_data_fact AS f
    (club_id, stat_date, kind, game_id, user_id, fee, buyins, cashouts, winnings, last_at)
  VALUES (p_club, p_day, p_kind, p_game,
          COALESCE(p_user, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid),
          COALESCE(p_fee, 0), COALESCE(p_buyins, 0), COALESCE(p_cashouts, 0),
          COALESCE(p_winnings, 0), COALESCE(p_at, now()))
  ON CONFLICT (club_id, stat_date, game_id, user_id) DO UPDATE
     SET fee = f.fee + EXCLUDED.fee,
         buyins = f.buyins + EXCLUDED.buyins,
         cashouts = f.cashouts + EXCLUDED.cashouts,
         winnings = f.winnings + EXCLUDED.winnings,
         last_at = GREATEST(f.last_at, EXCLUDED.last_at);
  -- 20261022103651: the same event, keyed by its America/Chicago day, from the
  -- Chicago cutover on (the one-time load owns everything before it).
  INSERT INTO public.ca_club_data_fact_ct AS c
    (club_id, stat_date, kind, game_id, user_id, fee, buyins, cashouts, winnings, last_at)
  SELECT p_club, public.fn_ca_chicago_day(COALESCE(p_at, now())), p_kind, p_game,
         COALESCE(p_user, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid),
         COALESCE(p_fee, 0), COALESCE(p_buyins, 0), COALESCE(p_cashouts, 0),
         COALESCE(p_winnings, 0), COALESCE(p_at, now())
   WHERE COALESCE(p_at, now()) >= public.fn_ca_club_data_ct_live_from()
  ON CONFLICT (club_id, stat_date, game_id, user_id, src) DO UPDATE
     SET fee = c.fee + EXCLUDED.fee,
         buyins = c.buyins + EXCLUDED.buyins,
         cashouts = c.cashouts + EXCLUDED.cashouts,
         winnings = c.winnings + EXCLUDED.winnings,
         last_at = GREATEST(c.last_at, EXCLUDED.last_at);
  INSERT INTO public.ca_club_data_game_ct AS g
    (club_id, stat_date, kind, game_id, fee, buyins, cashouts, winnings, last_at)
  SELECT p_club, public.fn_ca_chicago_day(COALESCE(p_at, now())), p_kind, p_game,
         COALESCE(p_fee, 0), COALESCE(p_buyins, 0), COALESCE(p_cashouts, 0),
         COALESCE(p_winnings, 0), COALESCE(p_at, now())
   WHERE COALESCE(p_at, now()) >= public.fn_ca_club_data_ct_live_from()
  ON CONFLICT (club_id, stat_date, game_id, src) DO UPDATE
     SET fee = g.fee + EXCLUDED.fee,
         buyins = g.buyins + EXCLUDED.buyins,
         cashouts = g.cashouts + EXCLUDED.cashouts,
         winnings = g.winnings + EXCLUDED.winnings,
         last_at = GREATEST(g.last_at, EXCLUDED.last_at);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_club_data_hand_put(p_club uuid, p_table uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  INSERT INTO public.ca_club_data_hands_ct AS h (club_id, stat_date, table_id, hands)
  SELECT p_club, public.fn_ca_chicago_day(p_at), p_table, 1
   WHERE p_club IS NOT NULL AND p_table IS NOT NULL AND p_at >= public.fn_ca_club_data_ct_live_from()
  ON CONFLICT (club_id, stat_date, table_id, src) DO UPDATE SET hands = h.hands + 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ca_club_player_page_core_20261006_chicago_basis(p_club_id uuid, p_start date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_end date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_sort text DEFAULT 'winners'::text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_cursor jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_today date := (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date;
  v_end date := LEAST(COALESCE(p_end,v_today),v_today);
  v_start date := COALESCE(p_start,v_end-13);
  v_sort text := LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(p_sort,''),'winners'));
  v_search text := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_search,'')),'');
  v_limit integer := GREATEST(LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit,100),200),1);
  v_union uuid;
  v_out jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.ca_can_view_whole_club_report(p_club_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized for this club' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_start < v_end-92 THEN v_start := v_end-92; END IF;
  IF v_start > v_end THEN v_start := v_end; END IF;
  IF v_sort NOT IN ('winners','losers','rake','hands') THEN v_sort := 'winners'; END IF;
  SELECT uc.union_id INTO v_union FROM public.union_clubs uc
   WHERE uc.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)) LIMIT 1;

  WITH att_club AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT cm.user_id FROM public.club_members cm WHERE cm.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id))
  ), record AS MATERIALIZED (
    -- Hands and cash results exactly as the Member record files them: the
    -- funded club, UTC days, this club's launch accounting cutoff.
    SELECT f.user_id,SUM(f.net) FILTER (WHERE NOT f.is_mtt) cash_net,SUM(f.hands)::bigint hands
      FROM public.ca_stats_member_record_daily_facts f
     WHERE f.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id))
       AND f.accounting_cutoff IS NOT DISTINCT FROM public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_cutoff('club',f.club_id)
       AND f.played_on BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
     GROUP BY f.user_id
  ), tournament_pnl AS (
    SELECT d.user_id,SUM(d.tournament_net) tournament_net
      FROM public.ca_stats_club_player_daily d
     WHERE d.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)) AND d.stat_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
     GROUP BY d.user_id
  ), wallet_pnl AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(r.user_id,t.user_id) user_id,r.cash_net,t.tournament_net
      FROM record r FULL JOIN tournament_pnl t ON t.user_id=r.user_id
  ), rake AS (
    -- Fees exactly as the Member record counts them: cash and tournament
    -- fees filed to this club, from the fee counting start.
    SELECT t.user_id,sum(t.total_fees) rake
      FROM unnest(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)) cc(id) CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.ca_club_member_fee_totals(cc.id,v_start,v_end) t GROUP BY t.user_id
  ), hands AS (
    SELECT r.user_id,r.hands FROM record r
  ), merged AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT a.user_id,COALESCE(public.fn_arena_name(pr.alias, pr.username, pr.display_name, pr.first_name, pr.last_name, pr.full_name),pr.username,'Player') username,
           pr.avatar_url,(public.fn_can_see_horse_flag(p_club_id) AND COALESCE(pr.is_horse,false)) is_horse,
           round(COALESCE(w.cash_net,0),2) cash_net,
           round(COALESCE(w.tournament_net,0),2) tournament_net,
           round(COALESCE(w.cash_net,0)+COALESCE(w.tournament_net,0),2) net,
           round(COALESCE(r.rake,0),2) rake,COALESCE(h.hands,0) hands
      FROM att_club a LEFT JOIN wallet_pnl w ON w.user_id=a.user_id
      LEFT JOIN rake r ON r.user_id=a.user_id LEFT JOIN hands h ON h.user_id=a.user_id
      LEFT JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id=a.user_id
     WHERE (COALESCE(w.cash_net,0)<>0 OR COALESCE(w.tournament_net,0)<>0
        OR COALESCE(r.rake,0)<>0 OR COALESCE(h.hands,0)<>0)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles dp
                         WHERE dp.id = a.user_id AND dp.status = 'deleted')
  ), filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT m.* FROM merged m
     WHERE v_search IS NULL OR m.username ILIKE '%'||v_search||'%'
        OR m.user_id::text ILIKE '%'||v_search||'%'
  ), scored AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT f.*,CASE v_sort WHEN 'losers' THEN -f.net
                           WHEN 'rake' THEN f.rake
                           WHEN 'hands' THEN f.hands::numeric
                           ELSE f.net END sort_value
      FROM filtered f
  ), page_plus_one AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s.* FROM scored s
     WHERE p_cursor IS NULL OR ROW(s.sort_value,s.user_id::text) <
       ROW((p_cursor->>'value')::numeric,p_cursor->>'id')
     ORDER BY s.sort_value DESC,s.user_id::text DESC LIMIT v_limit+1
  ), visible AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM page_plus_one
     ORDER BY sort_value DESC,user_id::text DESC LIMIT v_limit
  ), last_row AS (
    SELECT * FROM visible ORDER BY sort_value ASC,user_id::text ASC LIMIT 1
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'sort',v_sort,
    'rows',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'user_id',q.user_id,'username',q.username,'avatar_url',q.avatar_url,
      'is_horse',q.is_horse,'net',q.net,'cash_net',q.cash_net,
      'tournament_net',q.tournament_net,'rake',q.rake,'hands',q.hands)
      ORDER BY q.sort_value DESC,q.user_id::text DESC) FROM visible q),'[]'::jsonb),
    'next_cursor',CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM page_plus_one)>v_limit THEN
      (SELECT jsonb_build_object('value',l.sort_value,'id',l.user_id) FROM last_row l)
      ELSE NULL END,
    'has_more',(SELECT count(*) FROM page_plus_one)>v_limit,
    'filtered_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered),
    'generated_at',now()) INTO v_out;

  RETURN v_out;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ca_club_data_screen_chicago_basis(p_club_id uuid, p_start date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_end date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_game text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text, p_stakes text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 200)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
 SET work_mem TO '64MB'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_today date := (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date;
  v_end date := LEAST(COALESCE(p_end, v_today), v_today);
  v_start date := COALESCE(p_start, v_end);
  v_game text := UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(p_game, ''), 'ALL'));
  v_stakes text := UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(p_stakes, ''), 'ALL'));
  v_q text := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_search, '')), '');
  v_lim int := GREATEST(LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit, 200), 500), 1);
  v_scope text := public.fn_ca_club_data_scope(p_club_id);
  v_attrs boolean;
  v_mtt_win numeric; v_mtt_fee numeric; v_run_win numeric; v_run_fee numeric;
  v_users uuid[];
  v_role text;
  v_club_name text;
  v_union uuid;
  v_facts_from date;
  v_member_fees jsonb;
  v_sum jsonb;
  v_rows jsonb;
  v_days date[];
  v_zero constant uuid := '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
  v_games bigint; v_cash_fee numeric; v_tour_fee numeric; v_cash_win numeric; v_tour_win numeric;
  v_felt_ids uuid[]; v_felt_amt numeric[]; v_felt_seated int[]; v_felt_sum numeric;
  v_live_t uuid[]; v_cands uuid[]; v_need int; v_day date;
BEGIN
  IF v_scope IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized for this club' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_start < v_end - 92 THEN v_start := v_end - 92; END IF;
  IF v_start > v_end THEN v_start := v_end; END IF;
  IF v_scope = 'downline' THEN
    v_users := public.fn_ca_club_data_downline(p_club_id, auth.uid());
  END IF;
  -- Tournament attributes for every game only when a filter reads them.
  v_attrs := v_game IN ('MTT', 'SNG') OR v_q IS NOT NULL;
  SELECT c.name INTO v_club_name FROM public.clubs c WHERE c.id = p_club_id;
  SELECT cm.role INTO v_role FROM public.club_members cm
   WHERE cm.club_id = p_club_id AND cm.user_id = auth.uid()
   ORDER BY public.fn_club_role_rank(cm.role) DESC LIMIT 1;
  SELECT uc.union_id INTO v_union FROM public.union_clubs uc WHERE uc.club_id = p_club_id LIMIT 1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.unions u WHERE u.id=p_club_id) THEN v_union:=p_club_id; END IF;
  v_facts_from := public.fn_ca_club_data_facts_from();
  v_days := ARRAY(SELECT gs::date FROM generate_series(v_start, v_end, interval '1 day') gs);

  IF v_scope = 'downline' THEN
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('cash_fees', coalesce(sum(f.cash_fees),0),
      'tournament_fees', coalesce(sum(f.tournament_fees),0),
      'total_fees', coalesce(sum(f.total_fees),0), 'day_basis', 'UTC')
      INTO v_member_fees
      FROM public.ca_club_member_fee_totals(p_club_id, v_start, v_end, auth.uid()) f;
  END IF;
  IF v_game = 'ALL' AND v_stakes = 'ALL' AND v_q IS NULL THEN
    -- THE PLAIN SCREEN (20261017221938). Measured on production at 22:20 UTC,
    -- Club JAQK, 14 days: 3.79 s through the one-query form below, because
    -- the totals grouped 450,000 fact rows into 248,000 games to pick 200 of
    -- them, and the per-game player count was planned as a range scan per
    -- game. Here:
    --   * the totals are one aggregate over the window, never grouped by game;
    --   * the page's rows are chosen from the most recent days first - every
    --     fact's last_at falls on its own stat_date, so a game seen on a later
    --     day outranks every game seen only earlier, and the order is exact;
    --   * only those rows are totalled, counted and described, by exact
    --     (club, day, game) lookups.
    SELECT array_agg(x.table_id), array_agg(x.felt), array_agg(x.seated), COALESCE(SUM(x.felt), 0)
      INTO v_felt_ids, v_felt_amt, v_felt_seated, v_felt_sum
      FROM (
        -- Chips still in front of this club's seated players: part of the
        -- result, not a loss. The seat's own club, as the money was.
        SELECT s.table_id, SUM(s.stack) AS felt, count(*)::int AS seated
          FROM public.table_seats s
          JOIN public.tables t ON t.id = s.table_id AND t.tournament_id IS NULL
         WHERE s.left_at IS NULL AND s.user_id IS NOT NULL
           AND COALESCE(s.status, 'active') <> 'left' AND COALESCE(s.stack, 0) > 0
           AND (s.joined_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
           AND COALESCE(s.club_id, public.fn_ca_cash_reporting_club(t.union_id, t.club_id, s.user_id)) = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id))
           AND (v_users IS NULL OR s.user_id = ANY (v_users))
         GROUP BY s.table_id) x;
    v_felt_ids := COALESCE(v_felt_ids, ARRAY[]::uuid[]);

    -- 20261022165130: without a downline filter the totals are the per-game
    -- rows' (ca_club_data_game_ct is ca_club_data_fact_ct summed over players,
    -- written by the same statement): a third of the rows, the same sums and
    -- the same games.
    IF v_users IS NULL AND NOT (
    p_club_id='a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid OR
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.ca_horse_club_assignments a WHERE a.club_id=ANY(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)))
  ) THEN
    SELECT count(DISTINCT d.game_id),
           COALESCE(SUM(d.fee) FILTER (WHERE d.kind = 'CASH'), 0),
           COALESCE(SUM(d.fee) FILTER (WHERE d.kind <> 'CASH'), 0),
           COALESCE(SUM(d.winnings) FILTER (WHERE d.kind = 'CASH'), 0),
           COALESCE(SUM(d.winnings) FILTER (WHERE d.kind <> 'CASH'), 0)
      INTO v_games, v_cash_fee, v_tour_fee, v_cash_win, v_tour_win
      FROM public.ca_club_data_game_ct d
     WHERE d.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)) AND d.stat_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end;
    ELSE
    SELECT count(DISTINCT d.game_id),
           COALESCE(SUM(d.fee) FILTER (WHERE d.kind = 'CASH'), 0),
           COALESCE(SUM(d.fee) FILTER (WHERE d.kind <> 'CASH'), 0),
           COALESCE(SUM(d.winnings) FILTER (WHERE d.kind = 'CASH'), 0),
           COALESCE(SUM(d.winnings) FILTER (WHERE d.kind <> 'CASH'), 0)
      INTO v_games, v_cash_fee, v_tour_fee, v_cash_win, v_tour_win
      FROM (
   SELECT * FROM public.fn_ca_club_data_fact_window(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id),v_start,v_end)
    WHERE p_club_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid
   UNION ALL
   SELECT * FROM public.ca_stats_club_data_fact_ct
    WHERE p_club_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid
 ) d
     WHERE d.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)) AND d.stat_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
       AND (v_users IS NULL OR d.user_id = ANY (v_users));
    END IF;
    -- 20261022120121: MTT Winnings are FINISHED MTTs only (tournaments.status
    -- COMPLETED or CANCELLED); every other MTT's entries and payouts so far are
    -- Running MTT Entries. Both stay inside tournament_winnings, so
    -- total = cash + tournament still holds.
    -- 20261022165130: without a downline filter, from the MTTs (6,000 in all)
    -- to their per-game rows by key, instead of every tournament row of the
    -- window to tournaments (200,000 probes a fortnight for a large club).
    IF v_users IS NULL AND NOT (
    p_club_id='a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid OR
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.ca_horse_club_assignments a WHERE a.club_id=ANY(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)))
  ) THEN
    SELECT coalesce(sum(d.winnings) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(tr.status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED'),false)),0),
           coalesce(sum(d.fee) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(tr.status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED'),false)),0),
           coalesce(sum(d.winnings) FILTER (WHERE NOT COALESCE(tr.status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED'),false)),0),
           coalesce(sum(d.fee) FILTER (WHERE NOT COALESCE(tr.status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED'),false)),0)
      INTO v_mtt_win,v_mtt_fee,v_run_win,v_run_fee
      FROM public.tournaments tr JOIN public.ca_club_data_game_ct d ON d.game_id=tr.id AND d.kind='TOURNAMENT'
           AND d.club_id=ANY(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)) AND d.stat_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
     WHERE tr.tournament_type='MTT';
    ELSE
    SELECT coalesce(sum(d.winnings) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(tr.status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED'),false)),0),
           coalesce(sum(d.fee) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(tr.status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED'),false)),0),
           coalesce(sum(d.winnings) FILTER (WHERE NOT COALESCE(tr.status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED'),false)),0),
           coalesce(sum(d.fee) FILTER (WHERE NOT COALESCE(tr.status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED'),false)),0)
      INTO v_mtt_win,v_mtt_fee,v_run_win,v_run_fee
      FROM (
   SELECT * FROM public.fn_ca_club_data_fact_window(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id),v_start,v_end)
    WHERE p_club_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid
   UNION ALL
   SELECT * FROM public.ca_stats_club_data_fact_ct
    WHERE p_club_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid
 ) d JOIN public.tournaments tr ON tr.id=d.game_id AND tr.tournament_type='MTT'
     WHERE d.club_id=ANY(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)) AND d.stat_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
       AND d.kind='TOURNAMENT' AND (v_users IS NULL OR d.user_id=ANY(v_users));
    END IF;
    -- A seated table with no fact in the window is still a game on the screen.
    v_games := v_games + (SELECT count(*) FROM unnest(v_felt_ids) ft(id)
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (
   SELECT * FROM public.fn_ca_club_data_fact_window(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id),v_start,v_end)
    WHERE p_club_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid
   UNION ALL
   SELECT * FROM public.ca_stats_club_data_fact_ct
    WHERE p_club_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid
 ) f
                         WHERE f.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)) AND f.stat_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end AND f.game_id = ft.id
                           AND (v_users IS NULL OR f.user_id = ANY (v_users))));

    -- Running tournaments this club (or this agent's downline) played in.
    v_live_t := ARRAY(
      SELECT tr.id FROM public.tournaments tr
       WHERE tr.status = 'RUNNING'
         AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (
   SELECT * FROM public.fn_ca_club_data_fact_window(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id),v_start,v_end)
    WHERE p_club_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid
   UNION ALL
   SELECT * FROM public.ca_stats_club_data_fact_ct
    WHERE p_club_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid
 ) f
                      WHERE f.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)) AND f.stat_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end AND f.game_id = tr.id
                        AND (v_users IS NULL OR f.user_id = ANY (v_users))));

    -- The page: every live game, then the most recently active, newest day first.
    v_cands := v_felt_ids || v_live_t;
    v_need := v_lim;
    FOR v_day IN SELECT u.d FROM unnest(v_days) u(d) ORDER BY u.d DESC LOOP
      v_cands := v_cands || ARRAY(
        SELECT f.game_id FROM (
   SELECT * FROM public.fn_ca_club_data_fact_window(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id),v_start,v_end)
    WHERE p_club_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid
   UNION ALL
   SELECT * FROM public.ca_stats_club_data_fact_ct
    WHERE p_club_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid
 ) f
         WHERE f.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)) AND f.stat_date = v_day
           AND (v_users IS NULL OR f.user_id = ANY (v_users))
           AND NOT (f.game_id = ANY (v_cands))
         GROUP BY f.game_id ORDER BY max(f.last_at) DESC LIMIT v_need);
      v_need := v_lim - (cardinality(v_cands) - cardinality(v_felt_ids) - cardinality(v_live_t));
      EXIT WHEN v_need <= 0;
    END LOOP;

    WITH c AS (
      SELECT f.kind, f.game_id, SUM(f.fee) AS fee, SUM(f.winnings) AS winnings, max(f.last_at) AS activity_at,
             count(DISTINCT f.user_id) FILTER (WHERE f.user_id <> v_zero) AS players
        FROM (
   SELECT * FROM public.fn_ca_club_data_fact_window(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id),v_start,v_end)
    WHERE p_club_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid
   UNION ALL
   SELECT * FROM public.ca_stats_club_data_fact_ct
    WHERE p_club_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid
 ) f
       WHERE f.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)) AND f.stat_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end AND f.game_id = ANY (v_cands)
         AND (v_users IS NULL OR f.user_id = ANY (v_users))
       GROUP BY f.kind, f.game_id
    ), fe AS (
      SELECT x.table_id, x.felt, x.seated
        FROM unnest(v_felt_ids, COALESCE(v_felt_amt, ARRAY[]::numeric[]), COALESCE(v_felt_seated, ARRAY[]::int[])) AS x(table_id, felt, seated)
    ), rows_ AS (
      SELECT COALESCE(c.kind, 'CASH') AS k, COALESCE(c.game_id, fe.table_id) AS game_id,
             COALESCE(c.fee, 0) AS fee, COALESCE(c.winnings, 0) + COALESCE(fe.felt, 0) AS winnings,
             COALESCE(c.activity_at, now()) AS activity_at,
             (fe.table_id IS NOT NULL OR (c.kind = 'TOURNAMENT' AND c.game_id = ANY (v_live_t))) AS live,
             fe.seated, fe.felt AS on_felt, COALESCE(c.players, 0) AS players
        FROM c FULL JOIN fe ON fe.table_id = c.game_id
    ), top AS (
      SELECT * FROM rows_ ORDER BY live DESC, activity_at DESC NULLS LAST, k, game_id LIMIT v_lim
    ), described AS (
      SELECT CASE WHEN tp.k = 'CASH' THEN 'CASH'
                  WHEN tr.tournament_type = 'SPIN' THEN 'SPIN'
                  WHEN tr.tournament_type = 'SNG' THEN 'SNG' WHEN tr.tournament_type='MTT' THEN 'MTT' ELSE coalesce(tr.tournament_type,'TOURNAMENT') END AS kind,
             tp.game_id::text AS id,
             CASE WHEN tp.k = 'CASH' THEN COALESCE(t.name, 'Unnamed') ELSE COALESCE(tr.name, 'Tournament') END AS name,
             CASE WHEN tp.k = 'CASH' THEN UPPER(COALESCE(t.game_variant, 'nlh'))
                  ELSE UPPER(COALESCE(tr.variant, tr.game_type, 'nlh')) END AS variant,
             CASE WHEN tp.k = 'CASH' THEN
                    CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.game_variant,'') ILIKE '%plo%' OR COALESCE(t.game_variant,'') ILIKE '%omaha%' THEN 'OMAHA'
                         WHEN COALESCE(t.game_variant,'') ILIKE '%mixed%' OR COALESCE(t.game_mode,'') ILIKE '%mixed%' THEN 'MIXED'
                         ELSE 'HOLDEM' END
                  WHEN tr.tournament_type = 'SPIN' THEN 'SPIN' WHEN tr.tournament_type = 'SNG' THEN 'SNG' WHEN tr.tournament_type='MTT' THEN 'MTT' ELSE coalesce(tr.tournament_type,'TOURNAMENT') END AS game_class,
             CASE WHEN tp.k <> 'CASH' THEN 'NA'
                  WHEN COALESCE(t.big_blind,0) < 1 THEN 'MICRO'
                  WHEN COALESCE(t.big_blind,0) < 5 THEN 'SMALL'
                  WHEN COALESCE(t.big_blind,0) < 25 THEN 'MID' ELSE 'HIGH' END AS stakes_tier,
             CASE WHEN tp.k = 'CASH' AND COALESCE(t.big_blind,0) > 0 THEN
               trim(trailing '.' from trim(trailing '0' from COALESCE(t.small_blind,0)::text)) || '/' ||
               trim(trailing '.' from trim(trailing '0' from t.big_blind::text)) END AS blinds,
             CASE WHEN tp.k = 'CASH' THEN t.created_at ELSE tr.start_time END AS started_at,
             CASE WHEN tp.k = 'CASH' THEN t.status ELSE tr.status END AS status,
             CASE WHEN tp.k = 'CASH' THEN COALESCE(pr.username, '') ELSE '' END AS creator_name,
             round(tp.fee, 2) AS fee, round(tp.winnings, 2) AS winnings,
             GREATEST(tp.players, COALESCE(tp.seated, 0))::int AS players,
             tp.activity_at, tp.live, tp.seated, round(tp.on_felt, 2) AS on_felt, tp.k
        FROM top tp
        LEFT JOIN public.tables t ON tp.k = 'CASH' AND t.id = tp.game_id
        LEFT JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id = t.created_by
        LEFT JOIN public.tournaments tr ON tp.k = 'TOURNAMENT' AND tr.id = tp.game_id
    )
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
             'kind', kind, 'id', id, 'name', name, 'variant', variant,
             'game_class', game_class, 'stakes_tier', stakes_tier, 'blinds', blinds,
             'started_at', started_at, 'activity_at', activity_at, 'status', status,
             'creator_name', NULLIF(creator_name, ''), 'fee', COALESCE(fee, 0),
             'winnings', COALESCE(winnings, 0), 'players', COALESCE(players, 0),
             'live', live, 'seated', seated, 'on_felt', on_felt)
             ORDER BY live DESC, activity_at DESC NULLS LAST, k, id), '[]'::jsonb)
      INTO v_rows FROM described;

    v_sum := jsonb_build_object(
      'games', v_games,
      'total_winnings', round(v_cash_win + v_tour_win + v_felt_sum, 2),
      'mtt_winnings', round(v_mtt_win, 2), 'tournament_winnings', round(v_tour_win,2),
      'running_mtt_entries', round(v_run_win, 2), 'running_mtt_fee', round(v_run_fee, 2),
      'cash_winnings', round(v_cash_win + v_felt_sum, 2),
      'fee', round(v_cash_fee + v_tour_fee, 2),
      'cash_fee', round(v_cash_fee, 2),
      'mtt_fee', round(v_mtt_fee, 2), 'tournament_fee', round(v_tour_fee,2),
      'on_felt', round(v_felt_sum, 2),
      'live_games', cardinality(v_felt_ids) + cardinality(v_live_t));

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'range', jsonb_build_object('start', v_start, 'end', v_end, 'days', (v_end - v_start) + 1),
      'filters', jsonb_build_object('game', v_game, 'stakes', v_stakes, 'search', v_q),
      'scope', v_scope, 'reporting_scope', CASE WHEN v_union=p_club_id THEN 'union' ELSE 'club' END, 'reporting_club_count', cardinality(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)), 'accounting_basis', 'chicago_net_money_flow', 'day_basis', 'America/Chicago', 'viewer_role', v_role, 'club_name', v_club_name, 'facts_from', v_facts_from,
      'member_fees', v_member_fees, 'summary', v_sum, 'rows', v_rows, 'row_count', (v_sum->>'games')::int,
      'union_id', v_union, 'generated_at', now());
  END IF;

  -- A FILTERED SCREEN (a game class, stakes, or a search): every game's
  -- attributes are read, as before; the players are counted for the page's
  -- rows by exact (club, day, game) lookups.

  WITH g AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d.kind, d.game_id, SUM(d.fee) AS fee, SUM(d.winnings) AS winnings, max(d.last_at) AS activity_at
      FROM (
   SELECT * FROM public.fn_ca_club_data_fact_window(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id),v_start,v_end)
    WHERE p_club_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid
   UNION ALL
   SELECT * FROM public.ca_stats_club_data_fact_ct
    WHERE p_club_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid
 ) d
     WHERE d.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)) AND d.stat_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
       AND (v_users IS NULL OR d.user_id = ANY (v_users))
       AND (v_game = 'ALL'
            OR (v_game IN ('HOLDEM', 'OMAHA', 'MIXED') AND d.kind = 'CASH')
            OR (v_game IN ('MTT', 'SNG') AND d.kind = 'TOURNAMENT'))
       AND (v_stakes = 'ALL' OR d.kind = 'CASH')
     GROUP BY d.kind, d.game_id
  ), felt AS MATERIALIZED (
    -- Chips still in front of this club's seated players: part of the result,
    -- not a loss. The seat's own club, as the money was.
    SELECT s.table_id, SUM(s.stack) AS felt, count(*)::int AS seated
      FROM public.table_seats s
      JOIN public.tables t ON t.id = s.table_id AND t.tournament_id IS NULL
     WHERE s.left_at IS NULL AND s.user_id IS NOT NULL
       AND COALESCE(s.status, 'active') <> 'left' AND COALESCE(s.stack, 0) > 0
       AND (s.joined_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
       AND COALESCE(s.club_id, public.fn_ca_cash_reporting_club(t.union_id, t.club_id, s.user_id)) = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id))
       AND (v_users IS NULL OR s.user_id = ANY (v_users))
       AND v_game IN ('ALL', 'HOLDEM', 'OMAHA', 'MIXED')
     GROUP BY s.table_id
  ), running AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT tr.id FROM public.tournaments tr WHERE tr.status = 'RUNNING'
  ), cash AS (
    -- Cash games are few; every one is described.
    SELECT t.id AS game_id, COALESCE(t.name, 'Unnamed') AS name,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.game_variant,'') ILIKE '%plo%' OR COALESCE(t.game_variant,'') ILIKE '%omaha%' THEN 'OMAHA'
                WHEN COALESCE(t.game_variant,'') ILIKE '%mixed%' OR COALESCE(t.game_mode,'') ILIKE '%mixed%' THEN 'MIXED'
                ELSE 'HOLDEM' END AS game_class,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.big_blind,0) < 1 THEN 'MICRO'
                WHEN COALESCE(t.big_blind,0) < 5 THEN 'SMALL'
                WHEN COALESCE(t.big_blind,0) < 25 THEN 'MID' ELSE 'HIGH' END AS stakes_tier,
           COALESCE(pr.username, '') AS creator_name,
           COALESCE(gg.fee, 0) AS fee,
           COALESCE(gg.winnings, 0) + COALESCE(fe.felt, 0) AS winnings,
           COALESCE(gg.activity_at, now()) AS activity_at,
           (fe.felt IS NOT NULL) AS live, fe.seated, fe.felt AS on_felt
      FROM (SELECT * FROM g WHERE g.kind = 'CASH') gg
      FULL JOIN felt fe ON fe.table_id = gg.game_id
      JOIN public.tables t ON t.id = COALESCE(gg.game_id, fe.table_id)
      LEFT JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id = t.created_by
  ), tour AS (
    SELECT g.game_id, g.fee, g.winnings, g.activity_at,
           (g.game_id IN (SELECT r.id FROM running r)) AS live
      FROM g WHERE g.kind = 'TOURNAMENT'
  ), tour_described AS (
    -- Read only when a filter needs it: v_attrs is a one-time filter, so the
    -- tournaments join is never executed for the plain screen.
    SELECT tu.*, COALESCE(tr.name, 'Tournament') AS name,
           CASE WHEN tr.tournament_type = 'SPIN' THEN 'SPIN' WHEN tr.tournament_type = 'SNG' THEN 'SNG' WHEN tr.tournament_type='MTT' THEN 'MTT' ELSE coalesce(tr.tournament_type,'TOURNAMENT') END AS game_class
      FROM tour tu JOIN public.tournaments tr ON tr.id = tu.game_id
     WHERE v_attrs
  ), filtered AS (
    SELECT 'CASH'::text AS k, c.game_id, c.fee, c.winnings, c.activity_at, c.live, c.seated, c.on_felt
      FROM cash c
     WHERE (v_game = 'ALL' OR c.game_class = v_game)
       AND (v_stakes = 'ALL' OR c.stakes_tier = v_stakes)
       AND (v_q IS NULL OR c.name ILIKE '%' || v_q || '%' OR c.game_id::text ILIKE '%' || v_q || '%'
            OR c.creator_name ILIKE '%' || v_q || '%')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'TOURNAMENT', tu.game_id, tu.fee, tu.winnings, tu.activity_at, tu.live, NULL::int, NULL::numeric
      FROM tour tu WHERE NOT v_attrs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'TOURNAMENT', td.game_id, td.fee, td.winnings, td.activity_at, td.live, NULL::int, NULL::numeric
      FROM tour_described td
     WHERE v_attrs
       AND (v_game = 'ALL' OR td.game_class = v_game)
       AND (v_q IS NULL OR td.name ILIKE '%' || v_q || '%' OR td.game_id::text ILIKE '%' || v_q || '%')
  ), summary AS (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'games', count(*),
      'total_winnings', round(COALESCE(SUM(winnings), 0), 2),
      'mtt_winnings', round(COALESCE(SUM(winnings) FILTER (WHERE k = 'TOURNAMENT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournaments mt WHERE mt.id=filtered.game_id AND mt.tournament_type='MTT' AND COALESCE(mt.status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED'),false))), 0), 2),
      'running_mtt_entries', round(COALESCE(SUM(winnings) FILTER (WHERE k = 'TOURNAMENT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournaments mt WHERE mt.id=filtered.game_id AND mt.tournament_type='MTT' AND NOT COALESCE(mt.status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED'),false))), 0), 2),
      'running_mtt_fee', round(COALESCE(SUM(fee) FILTER (WHERE k = 'TOURNAMENT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournaments mt WHERE mt.id=filtered.game_id AND mt.tournament_type='MTT' AND NOT COALESCE(mt.status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED'),false))), 0), 2),
      'cash_winnings', round(COALESCE(SUM(winnings) FILTER (WHERE k = 'CASH'), 0), 2),
      'fee', round(COALESCE(SUM(fee), 0), 2),
      'cash_fee', round(COALESCE(SUM(fee) FILTER (WHERE k = 'CASH'), 0), 2),
      'mtt_fee', round(COALESCE(SUM(fee) FILTER (WHERE k = 'TOURNAMENT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournaments mt WHERE mt.id=filtered.game_id AND mt.tournament_type='MTT' AND COALESCE(mt.status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED'),false))),0),2), 'tournament_fee',round(COALESCE(SUM(fee) FILTER(WHERE k <> 'CASH'),0),2), 'tournament_winnings',round(COALESCE(SUM(winnings) FILTER(WHERE k <> 'CASH'),0),2),
      'on_felt', round(COALESCE(SUM(on_felt), 0), 2),
      'live_games', count(*) FILTER (WHERE live)) AS s
      FROM filtered
  ), top AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY live DESC, activity_at DESC NULLS LAST, k, game_id LIMIT v_lim
  ), pl AS (
    SELECT f.game_id, count(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS n
      FROM (
   SELECT * FROM public.fn_ca_club_data_fact_window(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id),v_start,v_end)
    WHERE p_club_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid
   UNION ALL
   SELECT * FROM public.ca_stats_club_data_fact_ct
    WHERE p_club_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid
 ) f
     WHERE f.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)) AND f.stat_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
       AND f.user_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid
       AND (v_users IS NULL OR f.user_id = ANY (v_users))
       AND f.game_id IN (SELECT tp.game_id FROM top tp)
     GROUP BY f.game_id
  ), described AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN tp.k = 'CASH' THEN 'CASH'
                WHEN tr.tournament_type = 'SPIN' THEN 'SPIN'
                WHEN tr.tournament_type = 'SNG' THEN 'SNG' WHEN tr.tournament_type='MTT' THEN 'MTT' ELSE coalesce(tr.tournament_type,'TOURNAMENT') END AS kind,
           tp.game_id::text AS id,
           CASE WHEN tp.k = 'CASH' THEN COALESCE(t.name, 'Unnamed') ELSE COALESCE(tr.name, 'Tournament') END AS name,
           CASE WHEN tp.k = 'CASH' THEN UPPER(COALESCE(t.game_variant, 'nlh'))
                ELSE UPPER(COALESCE(tr.variant, tr.game_type, 'nlh')) END AS variant,
           CASE WHEN tp.k = 'CASH' THEN
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.game_variant,'') ILIKE '%plo%' OR COALESCE(t.game_variant,'') ILIKE '%omaha%' THEN 'OMAHA'
                       WHEN COALESCE(t.game_variant,'') ILIKE '%mixed%' OR COALESCE(t.game_mode,'') ILIKE '%mixed%' THEN 'MIXED'
                       ELSE 'HOLDEM' END
                WHEN tr.tournament_type = 'SPIN' THEN 'SPIN' WHEN tr.tournament_type = 'SNG' THEN 'SNG' WHEN tr.tournament_type='MTT' THEN 'MTT' ELSE coalesce(tr.tournament_type,'TOURNAMENT') END AS game_class,
           CASE WHEN tp.k <> 'CASH' THEN 'NA'
                WHEN COALESCE(t.big_blind,0) < 1 THEN 'MICRO'
                WHEN COALESCE(t.big_blind,0) < 5 THEN 'SMALL'
                WHEN COALESCE(t.big_blind,0) < 25 THEN 'MID' ELSE 'HIGH' END AS stakes_tier,
           CASE WHEN tp.k = 'CASH' AND COALESCE(t.big_blind,0) > 0 THEN
             trim(trailing '.' from trim(trailing '0' from COALESCE(t.small_blind,0)::text)) || '/' ||
             trim(trailing '.' from trim(trailing '0' from t.big_blind::text)) END AS blinds,
           CASE WHEN tp.k = 'CASH' THEN t.created_at ELSE tr.start_time END AS started_at,
           CASE WHEN tp.k = 'CASH' THEN t.status ELSE tr.status END AS status,
           CASE WHEN tp.k = 'CASH' THEN COALESCE(pr.username, '') ELSE '' END AS creator_name,
           round(tp.fee, 2) AS fee, round(tp.winnings, 2) AS winnings,
           GREATEST(COALESCE(pl.n, 0), COALESCE(tp.seated, 0))::int AS players,
           tp.activity_at, tp.live, tp.seated, round(tp.on_felt, 2) AS on_felt, tp.k
      FROM top tp
      LEFT JOIN public.tables t ON tp.k = 'CASH' AND t.id = tp.game_id
      LEFT JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id = t.created_by
      LEFT JOIN public.tournaments tr ON tp.k = 'TOURNAMENT' AND tr.id = tp.game_id
      LEFT JOIN pl ON pl.game_id = tp.game_id
  )
  SELECT (SELECT s FROM summary),
         COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
           'kind', kind, 'id', id, 'name', name, 'variant', variant,
           'game_class', game_class, 'stakes_tier', stakes_tier, 'blinds', blinds,
           'started_at', started_at, 'activity_at', activity_at, 'status', status,
           'creator_name', NULLIF(creator_name, ''), 'fee', COALESCE(fee, 0),
           'winnings', COALESCE(winnings, 0), 'players', COALESCE(players, 0),
           'live', live, 'seated', seated, 'on_felt', on_felt)
           ORDER BY live DESC, activity_at DESC NULLS LAST, k, id) FROM described), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_sum, v_rows;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'range', jsonb_build_object('start', v_start, 'end', v_end, 'days', (v_end - v_start) + 1),
    'filters', jsonb_build_object('game', v_game, 'stakes', v_stakes, 'search', v_q),
    'scope', v_scope, 'reporting_scope', CASE WHEN v_union=p_club_id THEN 'union' ELSE 'club' END, 'reporting_club_count', cardinality(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)), 'accounting_basis', 'chicago_net_money_flow', 'day_basis', 'America/Chicago',
    'viewer_role', v_role,
    'club_name', v_club_name,
    'facts_from', v_facts_from,
    'member_fees', v_member_fees, 'summary', v_sum,
    'rows', v_rows,
    'row_count', (v_sum->>'games')::int,
    'union_id', v_union,
    'generated_at', now());
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ca_club_player_breakdown_chicago_basis(p_club_id uuid, p_start date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_end date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_today date:=(now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date;
  v_end date:=LEAST(COALESCE(p_end,v_today),v_today);
  v_start date:=COALESCE(p_start,v_end-13);
  v_lim int:=GREATEST(LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit,100),500),1);
  v_union uuid; v_out jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.ca_can_view_whole_club_report(p_club_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized for this club' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF v_start<v_end-92 THEN v_start:=v_end-92; END IF;
  IF v_start>v_end THEN v_start:=v_end; END IF;
  SELECT uc.union_id INTO v_union FROM public.union_clubs uc WHERE uc.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)) LIMIT 1;
  WITH att_club AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT cm.user_id FROM public.club_members cm WHERE cm.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id))
  ), record AS MATERIALIZED (
    -- Hands and cash results exactly as the Member record files them: the
    -- funded club, UTC days, this club's launch accounting cutoff.
    SELECT f.user_id,SUM(f.net) FILTER (WHERE NOT f.is_mtt) cash_net,SUM(f.hands)::bigint hands
      FROM public.ca_stats_member_record_daily_facts f
     WHERE f.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id))
       AND f.accounting_cutoff IS NOT DISTINCT FROM public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_cutoff('club',f.club_id)
       AND f.played_on BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
     GROUP BY f.user_id
  ), tournament_pnl AS (
    SELECT d.user_id,SUM(d.tournament_net) tournament_net
      FROM public.ca_stats_club_player_daily d
     WHERE d.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)) AND d.stat_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
     GROUP BY d.user_id
  ), wallet_pnl AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(r.user_id,t.user_id) user_id,r.cash_net,t.tournament_net
      FROM record r FULL JOIN tournament_pnl t ON t.user_id=r.user_id
  ), rake AS (
    -- Fees exactly as the Member record counts them: cash and tournament
    -- fees filed to this club, from the fee counting start.
    SELECT t.user_id,sum(t.total_fees) rake
      FROM unnest(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id)) cc(id) CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.ca_club_member_fee_totals(cc.id,v_start,v_end) t GROUP BY t.user_id
  ), hands AS (
    SELECT r.user_id,r.hands FROM record r
  ), merged AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT a.user_id,round(COALESCE(w.cash_net,0),2) cash_net,
      round(COALESCE(w.tournament_net,0),2) tournament_net,
      round(COALESCE(w.cash_net,0)+COALESCE(w.tournament_net,0),2) net,
      round(COALESCE(r.rake,0),2) rake,COALESCE(h.hands,0) hands
      FROM att_club a LEFT JOIN wallet_pnl w ON w.user_id=a.user_id
      LEFT JOIN rake r ON r.user_id=a.user_id LEFT JOIN hands h ON h.user_id=a.user_id
      WHERE (COALESCE(w.cash_net,0)<>0 OR COALESCE(w.tournament_net,0)<>0
         OR COALESCE(r.rake,0)<>0 OR COALESCE(h.hands,0)<>0)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles dp
                         WHERE dp.id = a.user_id AND dp.status = 'deleted')
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('range',jsonb_build_object('start',v_start,'end',v_end,'days',(v_end-v_start)+1),
    'rake_complete_through',v_end,
    'totals',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('players',count(*),'net',round(COALESCE(SUM(net),0),2),
      'rake',round(COALESCE(SUM(rake),0),2),'hands',COALESCE(SUM(hands),0)) FROM merged),
    'players',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('user_id',q.user_id,
      'username',COALESCE(public.fn_arena_name(pr.alias, pr.username, pr.display_name, pr.first_name, pr.last_name, pr.full_name),pr.username,'Player'),'avatar_url',pr.avatar_url,
      'is_horse',(public.fn_can_see_horse_flag(p_club_id) AND COALESCE(pr.is_horse,false)),'net',q.net,'cash_net',q.cash_net,
      'tournament_net',q.tournament_net,'rake',q.rake,'hands',q.hands) ORDER BY q.net DESC)
      FROM (SELECT * FROM merged ORDER BY net DESC LIMIT v_lim) q
      LEFT JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id=q.user_id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'player_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM merged),'generated_at',now()) INTO v_out;
  RETURN v_out;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_rake_by_agent(p_club_id uuid, p_start date, p_end date, p_limit integer, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'rake'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_now  timestamptz := now();
  v_from timestamptz := p_start::timestamptz;
  v_to   timestamptz := LEAST((p_end + 1)::timestamptz, v_now);
  v_uid  uuid    := auth.uid();
  v_cost boolean := public.fn_is_club_admin_uid(p_club_id);
  v_over boolean := EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.union_clubs uc
                             WHERE uc.club_id = p_club_id
                               AND public.fn_is_union_overseer(uc.union_id, v_uid));
  v_q    text := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_search,'')),'');
  v_sort text := lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p_sort),''),'rake'));
  v_out  jsonb;
BEGIN
  v_from:=public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_start('club',p_club_id,v_from);
  IF v_to <= v_from THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('rows','[]'::jsonb,'total',0,'total_direct',0,'total_commission',NULL);
  END IF;

  WITH RECURSIVE ok_days AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT rc.day FROM public.club_rake_rollup_complete rc
     WHERE rc.club_id = p_club_id
       AND rc.day >= date_trunc('day', v_from)::date
       AND rc.day <  date_trunc('day', v_to)::date
  ), from_rollup AS (
    SELECT rd.user_id, SUM(rd.rake_amount) AS rake, SUM(rd.hands)::bigint AS hands
      FROM public.club_rake_daily_user rd
      JOIN ok_days o ON o.day = rd.day
     WHERE rd.club_id = p_club_id
     GROUP BY rd.user_id
  ), from_live AS (
    -- THE DAYS NOT YET SEALED, read from the incremental rollup the triggers
    -- on rake_attributions keep exact. This used to scan the attributions
    -- themselves, which is fine at 04:00 and a third of a million rows by
    -- midnight - the panel healed every morning and failed every evening.
    -- Same cents, same rounding, same source table as the sealed days.
    SELECT du.user_id,
           du.rake_cents::numeric / 100 AS rake,
           du.hands
      FROM public.ca_club_rake_daily_user du
     WHERE du.club_id = p_club_id
       AND du.day >= date_trunc('day', v_from)::date
       -- A DAY IS IN RANGE WHEN ITS OWN MIDNIGHT IS BEFORE THE EXCLUSIVE END,
       -- never `<= date_trunc('day', v_to)`. v_to is either a midnight (ask
       -- for a range ending yesterday and it is TODAY's midnight) or now()
       -- itself (ask for a range ending today). The inclusive form got the
       -- second case right and the first case wrong, and put TODAY's rake into
       -- a report for YESTERDAY. Caught by comparing old against new under one
       -- snapshot before this shipped; four ranges agreed and that one did not.
       AND du.day::timestamptz < v_to
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ok_days o WHERE o.day = du.day)
  ), earned AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT COALESCE(a.user_id,b.user_id) AS user_id,
           COALESCE(a.rake,0)+COALESCE(b.rake,0)   AS rake,
           COALESCE(a.hands,0)+COALESCE(b.hands,0) AS hands
      FROM from_rollup a FULL OUTER JOIN from_live b ON b.user_id = a.user_id
  ), commission_days AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT g::date AS day,
           (m.complete IS TRUE OR (m.club_id IS NULL AND g::date >= f.first_complete_day)) AS complete
      FROM generate_series((v_from AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,(v_to AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,interval '1 day') g
      LEFT JOIN smarter_private.agent_commission_report_days m ON m.club_id=p_club_id AND m.day=g::date
      LEFT JOIN smarter_private.agent_commission_report_frontiers f ON f.club_id=p_club_id
     WHERE (g::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < v_to
  ), qualified_commission_days AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT day FROM commission_days WHERE complete IS TRUE
       AND (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= v_from
       AND ((day+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') <= v_to
  ), commission_earned_parts AS (
    SELECT d.user_id,d.amount FROM smarter_private.agent_commission_report_daily d
      JOIN qualified_commission_days q ON q.day=d.day WHERE d.club_id=p_club_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT a.user_id,a.amount FROM commission_days d CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT ac.user_id,ac.amount FROM public.agent_commissions ac
       WHERE ac.club_id=p_club_id AND ac.user_id IS NOT NULL
         AND ac.created_at>=GREATEST(v_from,d.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
         AND ac.created_at<LEAST(v_to,(d.day+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
         AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM qualified_commission_days q WHERE q.day=d.day)
       OFFSET 0) a
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ac.user_id,ac.amount FROM public.agent_commissions ac
     WHERE ac.club_id=p_club_id AND ac.user_id IS NULL AND ac.created_at>=v_from AND ac.created_at<v_to
  ), commission_earned AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT user_id,SUM(amount) amount FROM commission_earned_parts GROUP BY user_id
  ), commission_covered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s.user_id,s.period_start,s.period_end,
           max(s.period_end) OVER(PARTITION BY s.user_id ORDER BY s.period_start,s.period_end
             ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) reach
      FROM public.agent_commission_settlements s
     WHERE s.club_id=p_club_id AND s.period_start<s.period_end
       AND s.period_end>v_from AND s.period_start<v_to
  ), commission_unpaid_ranges AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c.user_id,GREATEST(COALESCE(c.reach,v_from),v_from) lo,LEAST(c.period_start,v_to) hi
      FROM commission_covered c WHERE c.period_start>COALESCE(c.reach,v_from)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.user_id,GREATEST(COALESCE((SELECT max(c.period_end) FROM commission_covered c
      WHERE c.user_id=e.user_id),v_from),v_from),v_to FROM commission_earned e
  ), commission_outstanding_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT g.user_id,SUM(ac.amount) amount FROM commission_unpaid_ranges g
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.amount FROM public.agent_commissions a
       WHERE a.club_id=p_club_id AND a.user_id=g.user_id
         AND a.settled_at IS NULL AND a.created_at>=g.lo AND a.created_at<g.hi OFFSET 0) ac
     WHERE g.lo<g.hi AND g.user_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM commission_fallback z WHERE z.user_id=g.user_id) GROUP BY g.user_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT NULL::uuid,SUM(a.amount) FROM public.agent_commissions a
     WHERE a.club_id=p_club_id AND a.user_id IS NULL AND a.settled_at IS NULL
       AND a.created_at>=v_from AND a.created_at<v_to AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM commission_fallback z WHERE z.user_id IS NULL) HAVING count(*)>0
  ), covered_islands AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT c.*,SUM(CASE WHEN reach IS NULL OR period_start>reach THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
 OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY period_start,period_end ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) island
 FROM commission_covered c
), covered_unions AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT user_id,GREATEST(min(period_start),v_from) lo,LEAST(max(period_end),v_to) hi
 FROM covered_islands GROUP BY user_id,island
), covered_days AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT g.user_id,g.lo,g.hi,s::date AS day,
 GREATEST(g.lo,s::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') day_lo,
 LEAST(g.hi,(s::date+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') day_hi,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM qualified_commission_days q WHERE q.day=s::date
 AND (q.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')>=g.lo AND ((q.day+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')<=g.hi) full
 FROM covered_unions g CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series((g.lo AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,(g.hi AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,interval '1day') s
 WHERE g.user_id IS NOT NULL AND g.lo<g.hi AND (s::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')<g.hi
), commission_paid_parts AS (
 SELECT d.user_id,d.amount FROM covered_days g JOIN smarter_private.agent_commission_report_daily d ON d.club_id=p_club_id AND d.user_id=g.user_id AND d.day=g.day WHERE g.full
 UNION ALL
 SELECT g.user_id,a.amount FROM covered_days g CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT ac.amount FROM public.agent_commissions ac WHERE ac.club_id=p_club_id AND ac.user_id=g.user_id
 AND ac.created_at>=g.day_lo AND ac.created_at<g.day_hi AND NOT g.full OFFSET 0) a
 UNION ALL
 SELECT a.user_id,a.amount FROM public.agent_commissions a
 WHERE a.club_id=p_club_id AND a.user_id IS NOT NULL AND a.settled_at IS NOT NULL
 AND a.created_at>=v_from AND a.created_at<v_to
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM covered_unions g WHERE g.user_id=a.user_id AND a.created_at>=g.lo AND a.created_at<g.hi)
), commission_paid AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT user_id,SUM(amount) amount FROM commission_paid_parts GROUP BY user_id
), commission_fallback AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT e.user_id FROM commission_earned e LEFT JOIN commission_paid p ON p.user_id=e.user_id WHERE e.user_id IS NULL OR e.amount::text IN ('Infinity','-Infinity','NaN') OR p.amount::text IN ('Infinity','-Infinity','NaN')
), commission_outstanding AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT e.user_id,CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NULL OR e.amount::text IN ('Infinity','-Infinity','NaN')
 OR p.amount::text IN ('Infinity','-Infinity','NaN') THEN
 (SELECT r.amount FROM commission_outstanding_raw r WHERE r.user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.user_id)
 WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM commission_unpaid_ranges g CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_commissions a WHERE a.club_id=p_club_id AND a.user_id=g.user_id AND a.settled_at IS NULL AND a.created_at>=g.lo AND a.created_at<g.hi AND a.amount IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) hit WHERE g.user_id=e.user_id AND g.lo<g.hi) THEN NULL ELSE e.amount-COALESCE(p.amount,0) END amount
 FROM commission_earned e LEFT JOIN commission_paid p ON p.user_id=e.user_id
), commission AS (
    SELECT e.user_id,e.amount earned,o.amount outstanding,
      CASE WHEN e.amount::text IN ('Infinity','-Infinity','NaN') OR o.amount::text IN ('Infinity','-Infinity','NaN') THEN
        (SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM public.agent_commissions a
          WHERE a.club_id=p_club_id AND a.user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.user_id
            AND a.created_at>=v_from AND a.created_at<v_to
            AND (a.settled_at IS NOT NULL OR public.fn_agent_commission_paid_by_period(p_club_id,a.user_id,a.created_at)))
      WHEN e.amount=COALESCE(o.amount,0)
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agents a WHERE a.club_id=p_club_id AND a.status='active' AND a.user_id=e.user_id)
        AND NOT EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_commissions a
           WHERE a.club_id=p_club_id AND a.user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.user_id
             AND a.created_at>=v_from AND a.created_at<v_to
             AND a.amount IS NOT NULL AND a.settled_at IS NOT NULL
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM commission_covered c
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_commissions a
             WHERE a.club_id=p_club_id AND a.user_id=c.user_id
               AND a.created_at>=GREATEST(v_from,c.period_start)
               AND a.created_at<LEAST(v_to,c.period_end)
               AND a.amount IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) paid
           WHERE c.user_id=e.user_id
        ) THEN NULL ELSE e.amount-COALESCE(o.amount,0) END settled
      FROM commission_earned e LEFT JOIN commission_outstanding o ON o.user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.user_id
  ), club_agents AS (
    SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.parent_agent_id, a.role, a.commission_rate
      FROM public.agents a WHERE a.club_id = p_club_id AND a.status='active'
  ), direct AS (
    SELECT cm.agent_id, COUNT(*) AS players,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(e.rake,0) <> 0) AS active,
           COALESCE(SUM(e.rake),0) AS rake, COALESCE(SUM(e.hands),0)::bigint AS hands
      FROM public.club_members cm
      LEFT JOIN earned e ON e.user_id = cm.user_id
     WHERE cm.club_id = p_club_id
     GROUP BY cm.agent_id
  ), tree AS (
    SELECT ca.id AS root_id, ca.id AS node_id, 0 AS depth FROM club_agents ca
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.root_id, c.id, t.depth+1
      FROM tree t JOIN club_agents c ON c.parent_agent_id = t.node_id
     WHERE t.depth < 12
  ), network AS (
    SELECT t.root_id, COALESCE(SUM(d.rake),0) AS rake,
           COALESCE(SUM(d.players),0) AS players,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.node_id <> t.root_id) AS sub_agents
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT root_id, node_id FROM tree) t
      JOIN club_agents n ON n.id = t.node_id
      LEFT JOIN direct d ON d.agent_id = n.user_id
     GROUP BY t.root_id
  ), unlisted AS (
    SELECT SUM(cs.earned) AS earned, SUM(cs.outstanding) AS outstanding,
           SUM(cs.settled) AS settled, count(*)::int AS recipients
      FROM commission cs
     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_agents ca WHERE ca.user_id = cs.user_id)
  ), listed AS (
    SELECT ca.user_id AS agent_user_id,
           COALESCE(public.fn_arena_name(pr.alias, pr.username, pr.display_name,
                                         pr.first_name, pr.last_name, pr.full_name),
                    pr.username, 'Agent') AS name,
           pr.avatar_url, ca.role, ca.commission_rate,
           COALESCE(dr.players,0) AS direct_players,
           COALESCE(dr.active,0)  AS direct_active,
           round(COALESCE(dr.rake,0),2) AS direct_rake,
           COALESCE(dr.hands,0) AS direct_hands,
           COALESCE(nw.players,0) AS network_players,
           round(COALESCE(nw.rake,0),2) AS network_rake,
           COALESCE(nw.sub_agents,0) AS sub_agents,
           CASE WHEN v_cost THEN round(COALESCE(cs.earned,0),2)      END AS commission_earned,
           CASE WHEN v_cost THEN round(COALESCE(cs.outstanding,0),2) END AS commission_outstanding,
           CASE WHEN v_cost THEN round(COALESCE(cs.settled,0),2)     END AS commission_settled,
           -- The same three conditions the downline walker enforces.
           (v_cost OR v_over OR ca.user_id = v_uid
            OR public.fn_is_agent_ancestor(v_uid, ca.user_id, p_club_id)) AS can_drill,
           false AS is_unassigned, false AS is_residual
      FROM club_agents ca
      LEFT JOIN direct dr ON dr.agent_id = ca.user_id
      LEFT JOIN network nw ON nw.root_id = ca.id
      LEFT JOIN commission cs ON cs.user_id = ca.user_id
      LEFT JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id = ca.user_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT NULL,'Unassigned',NULL,'none',NULL,
           d.players,d.active,round(d.rake,2),d.hands,
           d.players,round(d.rake,2),0,
           CASE WHEN v_cost THEN 0::numeric END,
           CASE WHEN v_cost THEN 0::numeric END,
           CASE WHEN v_cost THEN 0::numeric END,
           false, true, false
      FROM direct d WHERE d.agent_id IS NULL AND d.players > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT NULL,'Unlisted Recipients',NULL,'none',NULL,
           0,0,0::numeric,0::bigint,
           u.recipients,0::numeric,0,
           round(u.earned,2), round(u.outstanding,2), round(u.settled,2),
           false, true, true
      FROM unlisted u
     WHERE v_cost AND COALESCE(u.earned,0) <> 0
  ), totals AS (
    -- Before the filter. The denominator is the club, not the search result.
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.direct_rake),0) AS total_direct,
           SUM(l.commission_earned)       AS total_commission
      FROM listed l
  ), filtered AS (
    SELECT l.* FROM listed l
     WHERE v_q IS NULL OR l.name ILIKE '%' || public.fn_like_escape(v_q) || '%' ESCAPE '\'
  ), ranked AS (
    SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (
             ORDER BY f.is_unassigned,
               CASE WHEN v_sort = 'name'    THEN f.name END ASC,
               CASE WHEN v_sort = 'cost'    THEN f.commission_earned END DESC NULLS LAST,
               CASE WHEN v_sort = 'players' THEN f.network_players END DESC,
               CASE WHEN v_sort NOT IN ('name','cost','players')
                    THEN f.network_rake END DESC NULLS LAST,
               f.name ASC,
               f.agent_user_id::text ASC NULLS LAST) AS rn
      FROM filtered f
  ), sliced AS (
    SELECT r.* FROM ranked r ORDER BY r.rn
     OFFSET GREATEST(COALESCE(p_offset,0),0)
      LIMIT GREATEST(LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit,50),200),1)
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'rows', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg((to_jsonb(s) - 'rn') ORDER BY s.rn) FROM sliced s), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- Counted, not taken from a window over the page: ask for an offset past
    -- the end and a windowed count would answer "nothing matches".
    'total', (SELECT count(*) FROM filtered),
    'total_direct', (SELECT t.total_direct FROM totals t),
    'total_commission', (SELECT t.total_commission FROM totals t))
    INTO v_out;

  RETURN COALESCE(v_out,
    jsonb_build_object('rows','[]'::jsonb,'total',0,'total_direct',0,'total_commission',NULL));
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ca_club_game_page_core_20261006_chicago_basis(p_club_id uuid, p_start date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_end date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_game text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text, p_stakes text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'recent'::text, p_cursor jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_today date := (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date;
  v_end date := LEAST(COALESCE(p_end,v_today),v_today);
  v_start date := COALESCE(p_start,v_end-13);
  v_game text := UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(p_game,''),'ALL'));
  v_stakes text := UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(p_stakes,''),'ALL'));
  v_search text := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_search,'')),'');
  v_sort text := LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(p_sort,''),'recent'));
  v_limit integer := GREATEST(LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit,100),200),1);
  v_out jsonb;
  v_attributed boolean;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.ca_can_view_whole_club_report(p_club_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized for this club' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_start < v_end-92 THEN v_start := v_end-92; END IF;
  IF v_start > v_end THEN v_start := v_end; END IF;
  IF v_sort NOT IN ('recent','fee','winnings','hands') THEN v_sort := 'recent'; END IF;

  -- EXECUTE forces a plan for this club/window.  Shark Club previously crossed
  -- 20 seconds when PostgreSQL reused a generic parameter plan here.
  --
  -- THE PAGE READS WHAT IT SHOWS (2026-10-07). For Shark Club's 158,820-game
  -- fortnight this read the whole 1.1 GB tournaments heap to rank the games
  -- (143,527 pages), and counted players for every tournament the club ever
  -- had a row for (425,352 index entries, 203,737 heap visits) to show 200 of
  -- them: 2.2 s warm, 27 statement timeouts a day in production. The ranking
  -- now reads only a tournament's id, type and start time (covered by
  -- idx_tournaments_game_page_keys) unless the owner searches by name, and
  -- fee, winnings and players are read for the visible rows alone, by key.
  v_attributed := (
    p_club_id='a41434bb-8d0c-400a-8f0d-e8b3d65afed4'::uuid OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.ca_horse_club_assignments a
       WHERE a.club_id = ANY(public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs(p_club_id))
    )
  );
  EXECUTE $query$
    WITH felt AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM public.fn_ca_club_cash_felt($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6)), $query$ || CASE WHEN v_attributed THEN $scoped$scoped_games AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT d.kind,d.game_id,SUM(d.fee) fee,SUM(d.winnings) winnings
        FROM public.ca_stats_club_data_fact_ct d
       WHERE d.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs($1)) AND d.stat_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3
       GROUP BY d.kind,d.game_id
    ), raw_cash AS (
      SELECT c.game_id AS table_id,c.fee,c.winnings,coalesce(h.hands,0)::bigint hands
        FROM (
          SELECT game_id,fee,winnings FROM scoped_games WHERE kind='CASH'
          UNION ALL
          SELECT f.table_id,0,0 FROM felt f
           WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scoped_games g WHERE g.kind='CASH' AND g.game_id=f.table_id)
        ) c
        LEFT JOIN (
          SELECT table_id,sum(hands) hands FROM public.ca_club_data_hands_ct
           WHERE club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs($1)) AND stat_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3
           GROUP BY table_id
        ) h ON h.table_id=c.game_id
    $scoped$ ELSE $raw$raw_cash AS (
      SELECT c.table_id,SUM(c.rake) fee,SUM(c.net) winnings,SUM(c.hands)::bigint hands
        FROM (SELECT g.game_id AS table_id,g.fee AS rake,g.winnings AS net,0::bigint AS hands
                FROM public.ca_club_data_game_ct g
               WHERE g.kind='CASH' AND g.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs($1)) AND g.stat_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3
              UNION ALL
              SELECT h.table_id,0,0,h.hands
                FROM public.ca_club_data_hands_ct h
               WHERE h.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs($1)) AND h.stat_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3) c
       GROUP BY c.table_id
    $raw$ END || $query$), union_hands AS MATERIALIZED (
      -- 20261022134523: a union's raked cash hands per table, one grouped pass
      -- over the same rows fn_ca_club_data_hand_count reads, instead of one
      -- call per table.
      SELECT r.table_id,count(*)::bigint hands
        FROM public.rake_records r
       WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.unions u WHERE u.id=$1)
         AND r.created_at>=$2::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AND r.created_at<($3+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'
         AND r.tournament_id IS NULL AND r.is_tournament IS NOT TRUE AND r.rake_amount>0
         AND r.table_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT h.table_id FROM public.ca_club_data_hands_ct h
                             WHERE h.club_id = ANY (public.fn_ca_club_data_clubs($1)) AND h.stat_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3)
       GROUP BY r.table_id
    ), cash AS (
      SELECT coalesce(c.table_id,f.table_id) table_id,coalesce(c.fee,0) fee,
